THE PRIMA VOLTA SERIES

Cases that should not be possible

Detective Prima Volta works where ordinary crime, dangerous magic and inconvenient history overlap. Each novel is a complete mystery, while the world and characters develop across the series.

BOOK ONE

The Relic That Refused to Die

A dead archivist. A relic that remembers discarded outcomes. Evidence that refuses to stay settled.

When Elian Marr is found apparently dead inside a museum of dangerous magical artefacts, Prima discovers that the Veil Shard does not merely preserve history. It remembers the choices history threw away.

Amazon link coming soon

Amazon release pending

BOOK TWO

The Masque of the Empty King

People are committing crimes they cannot remember.

A dead language, stolen relics and a secret buried beneath an elven war lead Prima to an artefact capable of leaving a person recognisably themselves while somebody else makes the decisions.

Pre-order on Amazon UK

Pre-orders live · Releases 22 September 2026

BOOK THREE

The Veilborn Paradox

Most people leave a ghost after they die. Very occasionally, the ghost does not wait.

A series of impossible robberies leads Prima to a living man haunted by his own future ghost — and to the question of whether protection is still protection when it takes away a person's choices.

Coming soon

Coming soon

BOOK FOUR

The Death That Hadn't Happened Yet

His death certificate is genuine. The problem is that he is still alive.

A government record predicts a man's death three days in advance and names Prima as the investigator who will find his body. The paperwork may be more dangerous than the crime.

ABOUT THE AUTHOR

L. Fenra

L. Fenra writes fantasy mysteries built around impossible problems, dangerous artefacts and investigators who would prefer the evidence to behave itself.

The Prima Volta novels combine supernatural investigation, dark fantasy, character-driven mystery and understated humour. This website will grow alongside the series, with new releases, previews and future worlds added as they are published.
